[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | collector = y | ingame name=Norrhart Domains | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=548 }} [[Norrhart Domains]] is an area of the [[Far Shiverpeaks]] populated by [[Jotun]], [[Modniir]], [[Mandragor]]s and [[Elemental]]s ==Getting there== This is directly accessible from [[Gunnar's Hold]], [[Bjora Marches]], [[Varajar Fells]], [[Drakkar Lake]] and [[Ice Cliff Chasms]]. This can be initially reached through Ice Cliff Chasm. **[[Warning to Travelers]] ([[signpost]]) **[[Welcome to Gunnar's Hold]] ([[signpost]]) *There are stationary turrets along the north east side which fire [[Ice Dart]]s when approached. == Notes == * In [[normal mode]], the low level Charr from the [[Charr Invaders]] quest do not count as enemies for the [[Norn Hunting Party]] blessing. *{{Vanquisher|count = 258|low = 229|high = 286}} ** [[Baglorag Grumblesnort]]'s group is easy to miss as they patrol a long route in the northwestern section. ** There are fewer foes during [[Tracking the Nornbear]], but more during Charr Invaders. * There are several frost traps near the [[Modniir]] in the northeast. * The Modniir [[centaur]]s are hostile to the [[Mountain Pinesoul]]s. * Near the exit into [[Drakkar Lake]], 6 neutral Jotun giants circle two hostile Jotun warriors dueling with each other; you can safely watch the contest from an overlook. ** During the competition, the duelers are automatically healed when their health drops below 5%, making them invulnerable. You ''do not'' need to engage these other Jotun to complete a vanquish, unless they become hostile. ** To end their auto-heal, you must interrupt the event by approaching the ring from the west and aggroing the neutrals. You can pull them into two groups, each composed of a dueler with three of his "fans". {{bug|If you attack the two Jotun with a longbow and pull them out of the ring, they could follow the party without losing their invulnerability. If you approach the ring and the auto-healing Jotun turn hostile, it will be impossible to vanquish the area.}} {{Explorable areas in the Far Shiverpeaks}} [[de:Norrhart-Gebiete]]
